title: IndusInd Jio BP Mobility+ credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: The IndusInd Bank Jio BP+ Credit Card is a co-branded fuel and lifestyle card that gives accelerated rewards on fuel spends at Jio-bp outlets, along with benefits on categories like movies, dining, and online shopping. It’s designed for frequent drivers who want to save on fuel through cashback/rewards, surcharge waivers, and partner offers while also earning decent rewards on their regular day-to-day spends.
